say:0:1423366001:0.text: Magister, we got a letter from Orlana! She's invited us to her very first class!
say:0:1423366001:0.source_cn: 主人，欧罗娜写信邀请了我们去听她的第一堂课！
say:0:1423366001:0.male: Magister, we got a letter from Orlana! She's invited us to her very first class!
say:0:1423366001:0.female: Magister, we got a letter from Orlana! She's invited us to her very first class!

say:1:1423366002:0.text: Looks like it's almost time. Let's head over and see how it's going!
say:1:1423366002:0.source_cn: 时间差不多啦，我们出发去看看吧！

say:0:1423367001:0.text: Let's check and see if we have enough books.

say:0:1423368001:0.text: Looks like Orlana and Jamie are still getting everything set up!
say:0:1423368001:0.source_cn: 欧罗娜和詹米好像正在为开课做准备呢！

say:1:1423368002:0.text: And there are already so many kids here. I'm so happy for her!
say:1:1423368002:0.source_cn: 已经来了不少孩子，真为欧罗娜感到开心！

say:1:1423369001:1.text: You made it! Thank you for coming to my first class.
say:1:1423369001:1.source_cn: 你们来了！谢谢你们愿意来听我的第一课。

say:2:1423369002:1.text: Orlana, we saw how many kids showed up. Seems like they really like you!
say:2:1423369002:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，我们看到许多孩子也已经来了，看来你很受孩子们欢迎嘛！

say:3:1423369003:1.text: I owe it to all of you. If you hadn't brought it up in front of Lord Ravion, none of this would've happened. At first, when I told the adults and children here I wanted to teach, they didn't really trust me...
say:3:1423369003:1.source_cn: 这要多谢你们在沙利叶大人面前提起这件事。一开始我跟这里...

say:4:1423369004:1.text: But then Lord Ravion sent over books, paper, and supplies, and even promised to build a real school. That's when it changed.
say:4:1423369004:1.source_cn: 后来，沙利叶大人给我送来了许多书本纸笔，还说要在这里建...

choice_prompt:5:1423369004.text: But then Lord Ravion sent over books, paper, and supplies, and even promised to build a real school. That's when it changed.
choice_prompt:5:1423369004.source_cn: 后来，沙利叶大人给我送来了许多书本纸笔，还说要在这里建一所学校，大家才对我有了信心。

say:6:1423369005:1.text: This is happening because of you!
say:6:1423369005:1.source_cn: 有了你才有了这一切的开始！

say:8:1423369006:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜姐姐，是不是可以开始上课了呀？

say:9:1423369007:1.text: Looks like it's time... Let me do a quick headcount. One, two, three...
say:9:1423369007:1.source_cn: 到时间了啊……我数数孩子们有没有到齐，一，二，三……

say:11:1423369009:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜姐姐，是希娜！希娜没有来！

say:12:1423369010:1.text: What should we do? The other kids are all waiting. Should we go ahead and start?
say:12:1423369010:1.source_cn: 要怎么办？孩子们都在等着……要现在开始上课吗？

say:13:1423369011:1.text: No. Even if it's just one child missing, the class won't feel complete. I don't want to begin without her.
say:13:1423369011:1.source_cn: 哪怕少了一个孩子，我的课堂都是不完整的，不应该这样草率...

say:14:1423369012:1.text: Jamie, do you know where Sheena might be?
say:14:1423369012:1.source_cn: 詹米，你知道希娜现在可能在哪里吗？

say:15:1423369013:1.text: I'm not sure. She hasn't played with me much lately... but she's been hanging out with Jules. He probably knows!
say:15:1423369013:1.source_cn: 我不知道，希娜最近没有跟我玩……但希娜跟朱尔玩了，朱尔...

say:2:1423370001:1.text: Yeah, isn't it time for class? Why are we still waiting?
say:2:1423370001:1.source_cn: 老师，是不是到上课的时间了，怎么还不开始上课呀？

say:3:1423370002:1.text: Jules, do you know where Sheena is? She didn't come to class... We can't just leave her out there.
say:3:1423370002:1.source_cn: 朱尔，你知道希娜去哪了吗？她没有来上课……我们不能丢下...

say:4:1423370003:1.text: Sheena told me she's not coming back... Should we still wait?
say:4:1423370003:1.source_cn: 老师，希娜跟我说过……她不会来了。我们真的要等她吗？

say:5:1423370004:1.text: Can you tell me what else she said?
say:5:1423370004:1.source_cn: 可以跟老师讲讲，她还跟你说了些什么吗？

say:6:1423370005:1.text: She kept saying things like, "Orlana will go back to the royal city soon" and "She's just here for fun and will leave us eventually." Someone argued back, and she ran off.
say:6:1423370005:1.source_cn: 她一直跟我们说“欧罗娜很快就会回王城的”“她只是一时兴...

say:7:1423370006:1.text: Do you think... she feels like we gave up on her? But she won't even come to class...
say:7:1423370006:1.source_cn: 希娜会不会觉得我们抛弃了她……可是，她又不愿意来上课……

choice_prompt:8:1423370006.text: Do you think... she feels like we gave up on her? But she won't even come to class...
choice_prompt:8:1423370006.source_cn: 希娜会不会觉得我们抛弃了她……可是，她又不愿意来上课……

say:9:1423370007:1.text: She went south. If I had to guess, she's out hunting. That's what she does when she's upset.
say:9:1423370007:1.source_cn: 她往南边去了，我猜应该是去打猎了吧。她一不开心，就会去打猎。

say:10:1423370008:1.text: Thanks, Jules. Wait here. I'll find her and bring her back!
say:10:1423370008:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，朱尔，你先在这里等着，老师会把希娜找到带回来的！

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 你还记得希娜离开的方向吗？

say:0:1423371001:0.source_cn: 我们沿着希娜离开的方向找找吧。

say:0:1423372001:0.text: There's Sheena! She's being attacked by those capshrooms!
say:0:1423372001:0.source_cn: 看到希娜了！她在被幻灵孢菇攻击！

say:2:1423374001:1.text: Orlana? Why are you here? Shouldn't you be teaching?
say:2:1423374001:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，你不是在给他们上课吗？为什么会在这里……

say:3:1423374002:1.text: Don't tell me you've already quit. Jules and Jamie are going to be so disappointed! I knew they were wrong about you!
say:3:1423374002:1.source_cn: 难道你这么快就放弃了？朱尔和詹米他们会很失望的！哼，我...

say:4:1423374003:1.text: Actually, I came to find you, Sheena. Jamie, Jules, and Leni will all be in class... You should be there too. We're not starting without you!
say:4:1423374003:1.source_cn: 希娜，我是专程来找你，邀请你加入我的课堂的。我的课堂上...

say:5:1423374004:1.text: I don't need your class! I'm fine on my own. I always have been!
say:5:1423374004:1.source_cn: 我不需要跟你上课，我一个人自由自在习惯了！我一个人也能...

say:6:1423374005:1.text: Then I'll respect that. But I want you to know this: I'm not here on a whim.
say:6:1423374005:1.source_cn: 我尊重你的选择，我只是想对你说，我不是出于新鲜感才留在...

say:7:1423374006:1.text: I stayed here for one reason—I want to teach. That's what I really want to do. And I'm not giving up halfway.
say:7:1423374006:1.source_cn: 我留在这里只有一个原因，就是想成为一名老师，因为这是我...

say:8:1423374007:1.text: Do you have something you want to do? If not, maybe you're still searching. I just want to be someone who helps you on that journey.
say:8:1423374007:1.source_cn: 你有自己想做的事吗？如果没有的话，你现在也在寻找它的路...

say:9:1423374008:1.text: I know you're scared... Scared I'll walk away after you start to trust me. So you'd rather not take the first step at all.
say:9:1423374008:1.source_cn: 我知道，你……害怕被抛弃，你害怕把信任交给我不久后我却...

say:10:1423374009:1.text: That's why I need to promise you, and myself, that I won't give up. That I'll help you find what you're good at, so you can choose your own path someday.
say:10:1423374009:1.source_cn: 所以我觉得，我必须向你，也是向我自己作出承诺：我不会轻...

say:12:1423374011:1.text: I... I just want to grow up fast. I want to go to the royal city and find my mom...
say:12:1423374011:1.source_cn: 我……其实，我想快点长大，去王城，找我的妈妈……

say:13:1423374012:1.text: If you trust me, put your hand in mine.
say:13:1423374012:1.source_cn: 如果你愿意相信我，就把你的手搭在我的手上吧。

say:16:1423374014:1.text: You didn't have to say it out loud!
say:16:1423374014:1.source_cn: 你们看到就好，干嘛还要说出来！

say:17:1423374015:1.text: Jules and Jamie must be getting impatient. Let's head back. You've still got a class to teach.
say:17:1423374015:1.source_cn: 朱尔和詹米他们估计都等着急了，我们赶快回去吧。你还要给...

say:1:1423375001:1.text: Wow, Miss Orlana really brought Sheena back! That's amazing!
say:1:1423375001:1.source_cn: 唔哇，老师竟然把希娜带回来了，老师真厉害！

say:2:1423375002:1.text: But Sheena, I thought you said you weren't coming. What changed?
say:2:1423375002:1.source_cn: 希娜，你不是说不来上课嘛，怎么现在又过来了？

say:3:1423375003:1.text: Jules, zip it for once, will you?
say:3:1423375003:1.source_cn: 朱尔，你少说几句没人拿你当哑巴！

say:5:1423375004:1.text: Settle down, everyone. Now that we're all here, time for our first lesson to begin.
say:5:1423375004:1.source_cn: 孩子们，安静啦，我们的大家庭人终于齐了，老师要正式开讲...

say:6:1423375005:1.source_cn: 第一堂课的开头，老师想给你们讲一个故事。

say:10:1423375007:1.text: Once upon a time, there was a child who lived on the edge of a forest.
say:10:1423375007:1.source_cn: 从前从前，在森林的边缘住着一个孩子。

say:11:1423375008:1.text: Every day, she cleared weeds from the grassy field. She often wondered what lay deeper inside the forest, but never dared to go in.
say:11:1423375008:1.source_cn: 这个孩子每天的生活就是清理草坪上的野草，她每天在森林边...

say:13:1423375009:1.text: That's silly! What's there to be scared of in a forest?
say:13:1423375009:1.source_cn: 真奇怪，森林里面有什么好怕的，她竟然不敢进去。

say:15:1423375010:1.text: No one ever told her it was okay to enter the forest. They only told her it was dangerous.
say:15:1423375010:1.source_cn: 因为从来没有人告诉她，森林是可以踏入的。他们只告诉她，...

say:16:1423375011:1.text: Then one day, a kind mage came by and said, "If you're curious about what's inside the forest, why not go find out? I can go with you."
say:16:1423375011:1.source_cn: 直到有一天，来了一位好心的魔法师，魔法师问她，你既然想...
say:16:1423375011:1.male: Then one day, a kind mage came by and said, "If you're curious about what's inside the forest, why not go find out? I can go with you."
say:16:1423375011:1.female: Then one day, a kind mage came by and said, "If you're curious about what's inside the forest, why not go find out? I can go with you."

say:17:1423375012:1.text: So the mage went with her into the forest. There were wild beasts, sure, but there were also sprites. She became friends with the mage.
say:17:1423375012:1.source_cn: 于是魔法师陪她走入了森林。她发现森林里虽然有野兽，但是...
say:17:1423375012:1.male: So the mage went with her into the forest. There were wild beasts, sure, but there were also sprites. She became friends with the mage.
say:17:1423375012:1.female: So the mage went with her into the forest. There were wild beasts, sure, but there were also sprites. She became friends with the mage.

say:19:1423375013:1.text: This story's starting to sound familiar...

say:21:1423375014:1.text: The mage and the sprites taught her how to survive in the forest. And slowly, she realized she didn't need to be afraid of the forest anymore.
say:21:1423375014:1.source_cn: 魔法师和精灵教会了她在森林里生存的办法，她发现，原来靠...
say:21:1423375014:1.male: The mage and the sprites taught her how to survive in the forest. And slowly, she realized she didn't need to be afraid of the forest anymore.
say:21:1423375014:1.female: The mage and the sprites taught her how to survive in the forest. And slowly, she realized she didn't need to be afraid of the forest anymore.

say:22:1423375015:1.text: So what now? Should she stay on the grassy field, or start a life in the forest? She still wasn't sure where she belonged.
say:22:1423375015:1.source_cn: 可接下来要去哪呢？要继续待在草坪上吗？还是进入森林生活...

say:23:1423375016:1.text: Then one day, she saw something beautiful: The sprites were weaving a huge net from vines—a net that could catch dreams.
say:23:1423375016:1.source_cn: 偶然间，她发现精灵们在用藤蔓编织一种巨大的网，这种网可...

say:25:1423375017:1.text: A net that catches dreams? That sounds so magical!
say:25:1423375017:1.source_cn: 捕捉梦境的网……听起来就好漂亮！

say:27:1423375018:1.text: She thought so too! She couldn't look away. Right then, she realized that this was exactly what she wanted to do. So she picked up some vines and started to weave.
say:27:1423375018:1.source_cn: 她也这么觉得！她被那种巨大美丽的网彻底迷住了，她想，原...

say:28:1423375019:1.text: And guess what? Those hands that were so used to pulling weeds turned out to be surprisingly good at weaving vines.
say:28:1423375019:1.source_cn: 你猜怎么着？她那双清理惯野草的手，编织起藤蔓来反而异常...

say:29:1423375020:1.text: In the end, one less child played on the grassy field, and one more dream-weaver walked the forest.
say:29:1423375020:1.source_cn: 最后的最后，草坪上少了一个孩子，森林里却多了一个编织捕...

say:30:1423375021:1.text: That's the end of the story. Now, if you could be anyone from this story, who would you want to be?
say:30:1423375021:1.source_cn: 这个故事讲完啦。孩子们，告诉我，你们最想成为这个故事里...

say:32:1423375022:1.text: I want to be the kid! I want to meet the mage and the sprites too!
say:32:1423375022:1.source_cn: 我要成为这个孩子！我也要遇见魔法师和精灵！

say:33:1423375023:1.text: Me too! I want to make that dream net!
say:33:1423375023:1.source_cn: 还有我！我要去织捕梦网！

say:34:1423375024:1.text: I think I'd like to be the mage. Or maybe one of the sprites. Without them, the child might never have found the courage to enter the forest.
say:34:1423375024:1.source_cn: 老师想成为魔法师和精灵哦。你们想，没有魔法师的话，这个...

say:35:1423375025:1.text: And without them, she never would've learned how to survive or make the dream net.
say:35:1423375025:1.source_cn: 没有魔法师和精灵，孩子也不会学到在森林里生存和编织捕梦...

say:36:1423375026:1.text: It was thanks to the mage and the sprites that she found her true calling. And I hope I can do the same for all of you...
say:36:1423375026:1.source_cn: 因为有了魔法师和精灵，她才能找到自己真正想做的事。老师...

narration:37:1423375027:0.text: Orlana's story has the kids completely hooked. And just like that, their first lesson comes to a perfect conclusion.
narration:37:1423375027:0.source_cn: 欧罗娜的故事牢牢吸引了孩子们的注意力，属于孩子们的第一...

say:0:1423376001:0.text: Ravion summoned us out of the blue. Bet he's about to dump more work on us.
say:0:1423376001:0.source_cn: 沙利叶神神秘秘地让我们去他那边……不会是又要让我们干活吧。

say:3:1423377001:1.text: I've been waiting to see you, great Magister.
say:3:1423377001:1.source_cn: 期盼已久了，我的大魔法师。
say:3:1423377001:1.male: I've been waiting to see you, great Magister.
say:3:1423377001:1.female: I've been waiting to see you, great Magister.

say:4:1423377002:1.text: Alright, Ravion, what kind of job are you roping us into this time?
say:4:1423377002:1.source_cn: 沙利叶，你找我们来，不会是又有什么活要让我们干吧？

say:5:1423377003:1.text: The royal city's finally getting back on its feet. Order's been restored, construction's on track. From here on out, Essail need to figure things out on their own, without relying on <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:5:1423377003:1.source_cn: 如今王城的秩序已经恢复，各项建设也已经步入正轨。接下来...
say:5:1423377003:1.male: The royal city's finally getting back on its feet. Order's been restored, construction's on track. From here on out, Essail need to figure things out on their own, without relying on <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:5:1423377003:1.female: The royal city's finally getting back on its feet. Order's been restored, construction's on track. From here on out, Essail need to figure things out on their own, without relying on <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:6:1423377004:1.text: But today, I didn't call you here for work. I wanted to thank you, for everything you've done. And also... pass something along. From me, personally.
say:6:1423377004:1.source_cn: 这次请你们前来，是为专程表达对你们这段时间付出的感谢，...

say:8:1423377006:1.text: It's for Orlana. And I'd like you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, to be the one to give it to her. I think it'll mean more coming from you.
say:8:1423377006:1.source_cn: 这封信函是我想要交给欧罗娜的。我想，由<style=s...
say:8:1423377006:1.male: It's for Orlana. And I'd like you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, to be the one to give it to her. I think it'll mean more coming from you.
say:8:1423377006:1.female: It's for Orlana. And I'd like you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, to be the one to give it to her. I think it'll mean more coming from you.

say:9:1423377007:1.text: Ooh, a secret letter! Come on, let's go find her. Chippy is dying to know what it says!
say:9:1423377007:1.source_cn: 好神秘的信函！主人，我们现在就去找欧罗娜吧，满满想知道...
say:9:1423377007:1.male: Ooh, a secret letter! Come on, let's go find her. Chippy is dying to know what it says!
say:9:1423377007:1.female: Ooh, a secret letter! Come on, let's go find her. Chippy is dying to know what it says!

say:3:1423379001:1.text: Orlana! We've got something for you. Ravion asked us to give this letter to you personally!
say:3:1423379001:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，我们来给你送信啦。是沙利叶让我们亲手交给你的信函哦！

say:4:1423379002:1.text: From Lord Ravion...? I think I know what this is.
say:4:1423379002:1.source_cn: 是沙利叶大人托你们交给我的吗……我想，我大概知道信函的...

say:6:1423379004:1.text: If you're so curious, I'll open it and read it with you.
say:6:1423379004:1.source_cn: 好奇的话，我就打开让大家一起看看吧。

document:7:244:0.text:
Dear Miss Orlana,
In recognition of your noble character, exceptional intellect, and deep dedication to education, I, Ravion, founder of Commoners' District Elementary, am honored to extend a formal invitation for you to join us as a permanent member of our teaching faculty.
Here, you will share knowledge, spread hope, and guide these pure young minds. I believe your wisdom and patience will brighten the classroom and the children's lives.
<align="right">Ravion
document:7:244:0.source_cn:
致欧罗娜女士：
因您高尚的品格与卓越的才学，以及对教育事业的热忱，本人沙利叶，作为泽被小学的建校发起人，诚挚地向您发出邀请，决定长期聘任您为本校教师。
您将在这里分享知识、传递希望，守护这些纯真的心灵。我深信，您的智慧与耐心将点亮课堂，也点亮这些孩子的人生。
<align="right">沙利叶

say:8:1423379005:0.text: It's an offer letter! You're being invited to become the permanent teacher at the commoners' district!
say:8:1423379005:0.source_cn: 是聘任书！而且是一封邀请你长期担任泽被小学教师的聘任书！

say:9:1423379006:1.text: You must be really happy right now, Orlana!
say:9:1423379006:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，你现在应该很开心吧。

say:10:1423379007:1.text: Actually, Ravion and I had talked about this before. He told me he'd send something official.
say:10:1423379007:1.source_cn: 其实，之前跟沙利叶大人谈这件事的时候，沙利叶大人就提起...

say:11:1423379008:1.text: It was my idea to add the word "permanent."
say:11:1423379008:1.source_cn: 是我主动提议他，在聘任书上加上“长期”两个字。

say:12:1423379009:1.text: I thought maybe it would ease the kind of fears Sheena once had. That I'd leave them one day...
say:12:1423379009:1.source_cn: 这样，就不会有人产生希娜产生过的担忧，怀疑我会半途而废...

say:13:1423379010:1.text: I wanted to make a promise—to the kids, and to myself as well.
say:13:1423379010:1.source_cn: 我想用这种方式向他们作出承诺，既给这些孩子信心，也给我...

say:14:1423379011:1.text: I want to be here long enough to see this school grow, to watch the children run through it with joy, and to give them the wings to go anywhere they dream of...
say:14:1423379011:1.source_cn: 我有自信用我的时间将这座学校建设得越来越好，让孩子们能...

narration:15:1423379012:1.text:
As Orlana speaks, you can almost see the school she's dreaming of.
A place where children land like birds, rest for a while, and then fly off toward their future.
And beneath it all, the school takes root, grows strong, and stretches its branches tall, becoming a great tree that will stand for years to come.
